description: List the social media accounts connected to a Feedlio workspace. Each result includes `uid`, `platform_slug`, and `can_post`. Only accounts with can_post: true can be used with create_post — pass their `uid` as social_account_uid and `platform_slug` as platform_slug, exactly as returned. Never guess platform_slug from the account name. Accounts with can_post: false are connected for other features (e.g. inbox/messaging) and create_post will reject them; tell the user instead of retrying.

social_platform.description: Filter to one platform slug, e.g. facebook

name: list_social_accounts
title: List connected social accounts
